name: Oruro
sourceReview: GAMO documentation identifies a local Unidad de Catastro Urbano, making the municipality the evidenced local cadastral custodian. Its public documentation is organizational/procedural, not a public parcel service. GeoBolivia/GeoNode and OEP were checked as national/public map channels; no safe parcel layer or anonymous parcel response was verified.

queryReview.englishDiscovery: Completed; official GAMO, GeoBolivia, OEP, and gob.bo sources found, but no public Oruro parcel endpoint verified.
queryReview.localLanguageDiscovery: Completed in Spanish; official municipal cadastral-unit evidence found, but no public parcel viewer/API verified.
queryReview.geometry: No parcel geometry returned or retained

requestOutcomes: GAMO homepage and direct OEP query returned empty curl responses; GAMO's official manual, GeoBolivia landing page, OEP ArcGIS service metadata, and gob.bo procedure page were available through first-party web discovery. GeoNode direct/API requests timed out or returned HTTP 502. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA bypass, TLS exception, or unsafe field request was used.
scopeLimits: GAMO custodian evidence does not prove a public endpoint or citywide open coverage.
The OEP service is administrative/electoral mapping, not cadastral parcel data.
GeoNode timeout/502 and empty responses are service-access outcomes, not evidence of parcel absence.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, legal-description, or value fields were requested or retained.
Runtime readiness remains held pending independent serial adapter review.
uncertainty: No claim is made about parcel absence, geometry completeness, legal title, ownership, tax records, or internal municipal datasets. A zero verified parcel response is a public-access qualification result only.
